claims.statement: Consolidated GMV grew 17% YoY to Rs 2,318 crore in Q1 FY25.
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 4.5% in Q1 FY25 from 2.6% in Q1 FY24.
India Multi-channel Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 8.3% in Q1 FY25 from 7.7% in Q1 FY24.
Plan to add ~350 COCO stores in India over next 2-2.5 years (8-10 quarters).
Plan to add 12 stores in Saudi Arabia over next 24-30 months.
India Multi-channel GMV grew 18% YoY to Rs 19,389 million in Q1 FY25.
International GMV grew 12% YoY in Q1 FY25, impacted by UAE floods and Eid timing shift.
International Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to -16.6% in Q1 FY25 from -22.7% in Q1 FY24.
Consolidated gross margin improved ~199 bps YoY to 37.7% in Q1 FY25.
Added 147 stores YoY in India Multi-channel (20 COCO in Q1 FY25; 139 COCO full year).
Management declined to give PAT profitability timeline; said business performance will continue improving and cash profits already positive.
India Multi-channel margin improvement to continue via home brand share, COGS reduction, third-party brand terms, and international scale benefits; no material seasonality.
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA grew 66% YoY to INR 80 Cr in Q2 FY25
India Multi-channel Adjusted EBITDA grew 38% YoY to INR 110 Cr in Q2 FY25
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 100 bps YoY to 4.2% in Q2 FY25
Consolidated gross margin expanded 100 bps YoY to 37.3% in Q2 FY25
International business EBITDA loss narrowed to 18.9% in Q2 FY25 from 22.8% in Q2 FY24
Education business EBITDA margin improved to 23% in H1 FY25 from 16% in H1 FY24
Annual unique transacting customers increased 16.5% YoY to 9.4 million as of Sep'24
India Multi-channel AUTC grew 16% YoY in Q2 FY25
India Multi-channel orders grew 19% YoY in Q2 FY25
India Multi-channel GMV grew 21% YoY in Q2 FY25
International business revenue grew 25% YoY to INR 208 Cr in Q2 FY25
GlobalBees revenue grew 55% YoY in Q2 FY25
Education business revenue grew 46% YoY in H1 FY25
Total store count reached 1,124 as of Sep 30, 2024 including 498 COCO stores
Education business operates 300+ franchise preschools as of Sep'24
Plan to open a couple of offline stores in International market next year
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 6.4% in Q3 FY25 from 5.6% in Q3 FY24, a 30% YoY increase; nine-month margin rose to 5.1% from 4.0%.
India multi-channel adjusted EBITDA margin reached 11.2% in Q3 FY25, up 50 bps YoY from 10.7%; nine-month margin improved to 9.5% from 8.8%.
International business adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to -15% in Q3 FY25 from -16% in Q3 FY24; nine-month loss improved to -17% from -20%.
Globalbees adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 1.4% in Q3 FY25 from 0.6% in Q3 FY24 (2.6x); nine-month margin rose to 1.6% from 0.4% (5.9x).
Consolidated gross margin improved to 37% in Q3 FY25 from 34.5% in Q3 FY24; nine-month gross margin rose to 37.3% from 35.4%.

No specific numerical guidance given; management targets continuous quarter-on-quarter, year-on-year EBITDA margin improvement across all segments, aims for Page Industries-like bottom-line excellence over long term.
Expected ESOP charges INR 2,620 Mn for FY2026, INR 1,224 Mn for FY2027, INR 644 Mn for FY2028
International business peak losses are behind; EBITDA burn will reduce quarter-on-quarter in absolute value and percentage
India Multi-Channel adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 9.5% in FY25 from 8.8% in FY24, a 24% year-on-year growth
International business EBITDA loss narrowed to -16% in FY25 from -19% in FY24; absolute losses flat
Globalbees adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 1.4% in FY25 from 0.2% in FY24; Q4 turned positive at 0.7%
Preschool business EBITDA margin reached 24% in FY25, up from 18% in FY24
Consolidated gross margin expanded 159 bps to 37.4% in FY25 from 35.8% in FY24
Preschool operational schools increased to 363 in FY25 from 208 in FY24; student enrolments reached 18,470
Franchisee store net count flat over last six quarters; gross additions offset by churn in late single digits; selection criteria tightened
Globalbees core brands deliver ~7.5% adjusted EBITDA; other brands at -31% but share reduced from 14% to 8% of revenue; overall EBITDA to improve as mix shifts
International business aims for profitable growth over top-line chase; home brand penetration and cohort improvement to drive long-term margin expansion

Aspires to reach late teens adjusted EBITDA margin for India multi-channel business, benchmarking Page Industries, with no fixed timeline but commitment to continuous gross margin and marketing efficiency improvement.

Expects continued gross margin and EBITDA expansion for a significant longer period until aspirational goal is achieved, driven by home brand share growth, marketing efficiency, and operating leverage on fixed costs.
Middle East gross margin improvement in 4 years matched India's 7-year trajectory; target is to reach neutral EBITDA in a few years by focusing on home brand penetration and category mix.
Offline store capex ~INR 1,500 per sq ft; working capital ~INR 1,100 per sq ft for company-owned stores; FY26 gross block addition similar to FY25.
FirstCry franchisee and BabyHug COCO stores typically 1,500-1,600 sq ft; FirstCry COCO stores larger at 2,000-2,500 sq ft; CM-2 profitability similar for online and offline post marketing and rent.
Experimenting with local logistics partners in select cities to reduce delivery time from 6 hours to 3-4 hours; will expand to more cities to improve last-mile experience without increasing cost.
India multi-channel revenue growth expected in early teens for rest of FY26
Plan to add 90-100 COCO stores in FY26, similar to FY25
International business steady-state GMV growth seen at early to mid-teens in foreseeable future
Consol gross margin expanded 82 bps YoY to 37.8% in Q1 FY26
India multi-channel gross margin up 120 bps YoY to 37.8% in Q1 FY26
Globalbees core categories delivered 4.5%+ adjusted EBITDA margin post-corporate expenses in Q1 FY26
Consol GMV grew 9% YoY in Q1 FY26
International revenue grew 13% YoY to INR 207 crores in Q1 FY26
Globalbees revenue grew 31% YoY to INR 426.5 crores in Q1 FY26
First Middle East store in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to go live before end of Q2 FY26
India Multi-Channel H2 FY26 GMV growth sequentially better than H1; full-year revenue growth expected in early teens, hopefully better
International business to continue sustainable growth and loss reduction in H2 FY26 and FY27
Offline product portfolio realignment to depth strategy targeted for H1 FY27 rollout
In-house delivery network to cover 50% of shipments by mid-next year
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA grew 51% YoY in Q2 FY26; margin expanded to 5.8% from 4.2%
India Multi-Channel Adjusted EBITDA grew 14% YoY in Q2 FY26; margin expanded to 9.1% from 8.6%
International business loss reduced 52% YoY to INR 18.9 crore in Q2 FY26; EBITDA margin improved 1100 bps
Preschool business EBITDA grew 55% YoY in Q2 FY26
In-house delivery network expanded from 4 to 13 cities in 6-7 months; continuing monthly expansion
Faster delivery network covers 20% of shipments currently; target 50% by mid-next year
Company believes growth rate for both online and offline channels will be structurally much superior in FY27
Management expects structurally superior growth for India multichannel in FY27 as new initiatives scale
RocketBees to cover 45-50% of total shipment volumes by middle of calendar year 2025
Globalbees brand rationalization expected to complete in Q1 FY27
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA grew 25% YoY for nine months FY26, reaching 5.8% margin
India multichannel adjusted EBITDA grew 6% YoY to Rs 395 crore for nine months FY26
International business reduced adjusted EBITDA losses by 25% YoY in Q3 and 36% for nine months FY26
Globalbees core categories adjusted EBITDA at 4.9% for nine months FY26, up from 1.6% previous year
School business EBITDA margin at 31% for Q3 and 27% for nine months FY26
Globalbees core categories revenue grew 30% YoY to Rs 1,417.4 crore for nine months FY26
RocketBees is an asset-light model using third-party dedicated service providers on FirstCry's tech stack
RocketBees expanded from 13 to 22 cities by December 2024, delivering 20% improvement in delivery TATs
Capital Expenditure FY2026 Rs 1890.98 crore
Capital Expenditure FY2025 Rs 2054.41 crore
FY27 India multi-channel growth expected to be superior to FY26; EBITDA rupee growth expected double-digit
International business to continue reducing losses in FY27 as done in FY26
GlobalBees brand rationalization to complete by Q1 FY27; core organic growth from Q2
Plan to open roughly 100 stores in FY27 with mix of COCO and FOFO
RocketBees expanded to 62 cities by end Q4 FY26, delivering 40%+ online volumes; target 45-50% by mid-year
Qwik quick commerce expanded to 5 cities by end Q4 FY26; doing 20% of online orders in covered catchments; target 10% of total online shipments in FY27
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA grew 24% YoY to ~486 Cr in FY26; Q4 adjusted EBITDA grew 18% to 118.7 Cr
India multi-channel adjusted EBITDA margin 8.8% in FY26 vs 9.5% in FY25 due to gross margin pressure from diapering competition and manufacturing input costs
International adjusted EBITDA loss reduced 35% YoY to 90 Cr in FY26 (10% of revenue vs 16% in FY25); gross margin expanded 250 bps
GlobalBees adjusted EBITDA post-corporate 91.9 Cr (4.9% of revenue) in FY26; Q4 26.5 Cr (5.8%); 2.5x YoY improvement
Preschool segment EBITDA margin improved 220 bps to 27% in FY26 with 11% revenue growth
Management expects India multi-channel revenue growth to remain elevated in subsequent quarters of FY27 due to structural initiatives.
Management targets adding 90-100 net new offline stores in FY27.
International business aims to become EBITDA neutral as soon as possible, with losses reducing from 10% to 7% of revenue in Q1 FY27.
GlobalBees revenue growth expected to bounce back starting Q3 FY27 after a planned warehouse transition completes in Q2.
India multi-channel gross margin recovery expected to accelerate in Q2 and Q3 FY27, with full recovery of crude-linked cost pass-through by end of Q2.
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin was 4.24% in Q1 FY27 vs 4.98% YoY; absolute EBITDA grew 80% YoY after ESOP cost adjustment.
India multi-channel EBITDA margin declined 290 bps YoY in Q1 FY27 due to 260 bps gross margin impact from diapering competition and crude-linked costs, and 30 bps from logistics initiatives.
International business gross margin expanded 280 bps YoY in Q1 FY27, driving adjusted EBITDA loss reduction from 10% to 7% of revenue.
GlobalBees adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 4.3% in Q1 FY27 from 1% YoY, a 290 bps improvement.
Pre-school adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 26% in Q1 FY27 from 23% YoY.
RocketBees expanded to 72 cities covering over 50% of online shipments in Q1 FY27, with ~20% improvement in delivery turnaround time.
FC Qwik expanded to 12 cities with 125,000 shipments in June 2026, up from 60,000 in March 2026 across 5 cities.
Offline GMV grew 15% YoY in Q1 FY27 driven by width-to-depth product assortment strategy.
Offline store expansion paused for capital efficiency; now resuming with 90-100 net new stores targeted in FY27.
RocketBees delivery framework scaled to 72 cities covering 50%+ of online volumes; FC Qwik in 12 cities with 2-hour delivery in select pincodes.
Management expects India Multi-channel growth momentum to continue in subsequent quarters
India Multi-channel gross margin expected to improve further in Q3 FY27
Manufacturing gross margin recovery expected from Q4 FY27 if crude price decline continues
Globalbees warehouse transition completed in Q2 FY27, growth recovery expected from Q3 FY27
Expect Q3 growth better than Q2 and significant gross margin improvement in Q3 and Q4 for India Multichannel
Target 50-60 new store additions in H2 FY27 and 90-100 stores per year for next 2-3 years
Expect Globalbees Q3 to deliver stronger growth and improved margins with rationalization complete
Mid to late teens revenue growth expected for India Multichannel for longer duration
Mid-teen growth would lead to revenue doubling in 5-6 years, not by FY30
International gross margin improved 220 bps YoY to 28.5% in Q2 FY27; adjusted EBITDA loss reduced to 6.4% of revenue from 8%
Globalbees adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 3.6% in Q2 FY27 from 2.1% YoY; H1 FY27 at 3.8% vs 2.9% FY26
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin 4.9% in Q2 FY27 vs 5.8% YoY; 70 bps cost savings below gross margin partially offset gross margin pressure
Preschool adjusted EBITDA margin 40.3% of net revenue in Q2 FY27, up from Rs 2.9 Cr to Rs 5.3 Cr absolute
Rocketbees expanded to 102 cities covering 60% of online shipments; 20% faster delivery, 90%+ on-time, 50% less RTO, 60% fewer delivery complaints
FirstCry Qwik expanded to 16 cities from 3; shipment count doubled from March to June and June to September; target 10% of online volume long-term
Store capex ~Rs 2,000-2,200 per sq ft for 3,000-4,000 sq ft stores; Swara manufacturing capex Rs 250 Cr last 2 years + Rs 500 Cr ongoing
